globalAttributes.name: hx-get
globalAttributes.description: Issues a GET request to the given URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

globalAttributes.name: hx-post
globalAttributes.description: Issues a POST request to the given URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

globalAttributes.name: hx-put
globalAttributes.description: Issues a PUT request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-patch
globalAttributes.description: Issues a PATCH request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-delete
globalAttributes.description: Issues a DELETE request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-trigger
globalAttributes.description: Specifies the event that triggers the request (default varies by element).

globalAttributes.name: hx-target
globalAttributes.description: Selects the element the response is swapped into (default: the triggering element).

globalAttributes.name: hx-swap
globalAttributes.description: Controls how the response is swapped in relative to the target (innerHTML, outerHTML, beforeend, afterbegin, ...).

globalAttributes.name: hx-swap-oob
globalAttributes.description: Marks content in the response as an out-of-band swap into a different part of the page.

globalAttributes.name: hx-select
globalAttributes.description: Selects a subset of the response HTML to swap in, by CSS selector.

globalAttributes.name: hx-select-oob
globalAttributes.description: Selects content from the response to swap in out-of-band, by CSS selector.

globalAttributes.name: hx-vals
globalAttributes.description: Adds extra values (JSON) to the request parameters.

globalAttributes.name: hx-headers
globalAttributes.description: Adds extra headers (JSON) to the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-confirm
globalAttributes.description: Shows a confirm() dialog before issuing the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-indicator
globalAttributes.description: Selects the element to apply the htmx-request class to while the request is in flight.

globalAttributes.name: hx-push-url
globalAttributes.description: Pushes a URL into the browser history.

globalAttributes.name: hx-replace-url
globalAttributes.description: Replaces the current URL in the browser history.

globalAttributes.name: hx-boost
globalAttributes.description: Progressively enhances anchors/forms to issue an ajax request instead of a full page load.

globalAttributes.name: hx-history-elt
globalAttributes.description: Specifies the element used for history snapshots (default: body).

globalAttributes.name: hx-include
globalAttributes.description: Includes additional elements' values in the request, by CSS selector.

globalAttributes.name: hx-params
globalAttributes.description: Filters which parameters are submitted with the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disable
globalAttributes.description: Disables htmx processing for this element and its children.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disabled-elt
globalAttributes.description: Selects an element to add the disabled attribute to while a request is in flight.

globalAttributes.name: hx-encoding
globalAttributes.description: Sets the encoding type for the request (e.g. multipart/form-data).

globalAttributes.name: hx-ext
globalAttributes.description: Enables an htmx extension for this element and its children.

globalAttributes.name: hx-preserve
globalAttributes.description: Preserves this element across a swap (by id), instead of replacing it.

globalAttributes.name: hx-prompt
globalAttributes.description: Shows a prompt() dialog before issuing the request; the value is sent as a header.

globalAttributes.name: hx-request
globalAttributes.description: Configures request options (e.g. timeout, credentials) as JSON.

globalAttributes.name: hx-sync
globalAttributes.description: Synchronizes requests between elements (e.g. abort/replace/queue).

globalAttributes.name: hx-validate
globalAttributes.description: Forces HTML5 validation before a non-form element's request is issued.

globalAttributes.name: hx-ws
globalAttributes.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection (htmx ws extension).

globalAttributes.name: hx-sse
globalAttributes.description: Establishes a Server-Sent Events connection (htmx sse extension).
